title: CSIR CDRI Notification 2026 - Walk-in-Interview for 16 Project Associate I, Project Technical Support and Other Posts
description: CSIR - Central Drug Research Institute (CSIR-CDRI) has declared the official notification for 16 Project Associate, Project Assistant, Project Technical Support, Research Associate, and Other Posts. Candidates who have completed their 10th Pass, B.Sc., Diploma, DMLT, M.Pharm, Ph.D., M.Sc., or Post Graduation can grab this chance and apply for the CSIR CDRI Notification 2026 .
